payload.text: hv's one release sitting, from dc's runbook (decision 24); each item is released as hv does it. (2) The three geodica.apple.{APPLE_ID,APPLE_APP_PASSWORD,APPLE_TEAM_ID} keychain entries. (3) The keychain Allow for codesign on the Developer ID key, already in the login keychain, and the first notarytool submission (ST0002 WP07). (5) The pushes: main, candidate/v2.0.0 for its CI, then the v2.0.0 tag and release (WP06). (6) The tap: formula publish and gh repo edit's description (AC-04.2); then brew install, brew test and pplr --version from the tap; pplr use brew and the handler; a reinstall and sync --check from iTerm (AC-06.2). Off the critical path: (4) the Intent fixes (watchouts 1 to 3); (7) the Devbin issue on dc/devbin-issue (84972b4), whose fix brings back brew style, brew audit --strict and the tap's CI. Each push is hv's, from the terminal: the auto-mode classifier refuses one from vc's session.
